doc: Hand-derived from pt.gd and Godot 4.5.1's GPUParticles2D and ParticleProcessMaterial (scene/2d/gpu_particles_2d.cpp, scene/resources/particle_process_material.{h,cpp}), not measured (README.md). A cell's emitter is the hook-log rid whose last accepted particles_set_amount has the cell's `amount` (unique per cell; the GPUParticles2D constructor sets 8 first). `calls` are the exact counts of each hooked particles call per cell up to the last transaction's frame (keys without the `particles_` prefix; the constructor's own calls included: create, set_mode, set_draw_passes, set_draw_pass_mesh, set_emitting, set_one_shot(false) and its restart, set_seed, set_amount 8, set_amount_ratio, set_lifetime, set_fixed_fps twice, set_fractional_delta, set_interpolate, set_pre_process_time, set_explosiveness_ratio, set_randomness_ratio, set_custom_aabb, set_use_local_coordinates, set_draw_order, set_speed_scale, set_collision_base_size; then _particles()'s amount, lifetime, seed, local_coords, process_material and texture, ENTER_TREE's set_speed_scale, one NOTIFICATION_DRAW's set_trail_bind_poses, and one set_emission_transform from the first transform flush: CanvasItem's ENTER_TREE puts every item on the tree's xform_change_list, and GPUParticles2D answers NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whatever its local_coords). `teardown` counts the calls after the last transaction (the quit: EXIT_TREE's set_subemitter(RID()) and the destructor's free). `per_frame` names the calls a cell makes every frame from its first such call to its last, over at least `min_per_frame_frames` frames, at most `calls[name]` more than the frames (B_SPHERE's emission transform: its parent moves every frame). `ranges` bounds a call whose count depends on engine timing [min, max] (B_SPHERE's emitter velocity: set only when the per-physics-tick velocity changes, at the start and around each 30-frame wrap). `restarts`, `emits` and `process_requests` are the cell's counters at the last transaction. `key` is the ParticleProcessMaterial::MaterialKey of the cell's process material, spelled as the wire builtin (render-stream-12.md); `textures` names the material's texture parameters that are float textures (F_CURVES: a 64x1 RGBF CurveTexture and a 64x1 RGBAF GradientTexture1D with use_hdr). Headless (the dummy) behaves the same for every particles call (the scene does not know the host); without the particles shim every emitter is RID() there.

pixels.doc: PM6a (gate8-pt-receiver-checks.ts). regions: each cell's emitter region, inclusive [x0, y0, x1, y1]: the unarmed reference's ink bounds over its eight shots at PM6a plus 16 px, clipped to the cell grid (I_TRAILS, which never draws, a box around its emitter); background: a pixel nothing draws; tail_frames: the fixture's shots after step 2; dark: the shots at which a cell has no ink (D_ONESHOT before its first restart at 20, and at 110, one lifetime after its last restart at 40; I_TRAILS always: 4.5.1's GLES3 does not support particle trails, particles_storage.cpp:301-310, so a trail emitter draws nothing on the gl_compatibility host and receivers alike); coverage_band: pt-coverage's factor.
